zh: 听说邻村有人炼丹炸穿了房顶。
en: Word is someone in the next village blew the roof off making pills.

zh: 据说山中野兽最近变得格外凶猛。
en: Beasts in the mountains have apparently grown unusually fierce lately.

zh: 有传言说近期会有渡劫的异动。
en: Rumor has it there has been strange tribulation activity nearby.

zh: 听说集市的灵石价格又涨了。
en: Word is spirit stone prices at the market rose again.

zh: 有人说后山的妖兽精变成了人形。
en: Some say a beast spirit in the back mountains has taken human form.

zh: 村里来了个走方的郎中，专治走火入魔。
en: A traveling doctor came through town, specializing in qi deviation.

zh: 据说东边山谷里藏着一座废弃的丹炉。
en: Rumor has it there's an abandoned alchemy furnace hidden in the eastern valley.

zh: 听说某位先天高人闭关三年终于出关了。
en: Word is an Innate-realm elder finally emerged after three years of seclusion.

zh: 镖局的人说最近山道上不太太平。
en: The escort guild says the mountain roads haven't been safe lately.

zh: 有人在井里捞到了一块发光的石头。
en: Someone fished a glowing stone out of the village well.

zh: 据说武馆最近收了个天赋异禀的新弟子。
en: Word is the martial hall just took in a disciple with unusual talent.

zh: 听说镇上的丹药铺老板悄悄涨价了。
en: Word is the pill shop owner in town quietly raised prices again.

zh: 炼气期的修士据说已经能听懂鸟语了。
en: Qi Refining cultivators are said to be able to understand birdsong now.

zh: 有人说月圆之夜山里会传出奇怪的声音。
en: Some say strange sounds echo from the mountains on full moon nights.

zh: 据说隔壁镖局丢了一批灵石，至今没找到。
en: Word is the escort guild next door lost a shipment of spirit stones, still missing.
